title: THE CARD CAPTIONS ARE READABLE
why: Seen on the 4K Mainframe screenshot of 2026-10-08: the small captions on the cream cards (PROGRESS and REWARDS on a contract, REQUIRED RESOURCES on a recipe) were 10.5 pixels, the smallest print left on the Mainframe. They are 12.5 now.
now: PROGRESS, REWARDS and REQUIRED RESOURCES on the cream cards are easier to read.

edits.replacement: .crlab{ font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.16em; color:#6a655a; margin:4px 0 7px; }   /* v16.xx, seen on the 4K Mainframe screenshot (2026-10-08): PROGRESS, REWARDS and REQUIRED RESOURCES were 10.5px captions */
